connectorUiConfig.title: Exchange Security Insights On-Premises Collector (Azure Monitor)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Connector used to push Exchange On-Premises Security configuration for Microsoft Sentinel Analysis using Azure Monitor Ingestion API.

sampleQueries.description: View how many Configuration entries exist on the table
sampleQueries.query: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize by GenerationInstanceID_g, EntryDate_s, ESIEnvironment_s

dataTypes.name: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize Time = max(todatetime(EntryDate_s)) by GenerationInstanceID_g, ESIEnvironment_s  | where isnotempty(Time) |summarize Time = max(Time) | project Time

value: ESIAPIExchangeOnPremisesConfig_CL | summarize LastLogReceived = max(todatetime(EntryDate_s)) by GenerationInstanceID_g, ESIEnvironment_s |take 1  | project IsConnected = true

parameters.text:
NOTE - UPDATE:

We recommend to Update the Collector to Version 8.0.0.0 or higher AND switching to new Log Monitor API.
The Collector Script Update procedure could be found here : ESI On-Premises Collector Update, Update to Log Monitor API procedure could be found here : Migrate From Log Analytics API To Log Ingestion API.
The new version of the Collector is using DCR (Data Collection Rules) for data collection. You need to configure DCR before running the script.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM Resources and Provide the Required Permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables your Exchange Online Collector to push Exchange Configuration/Audit directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application 
Clicking on "Deploy" will trigger the creation of a Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR). 
It will then create an Entra application, link the DCR to it, and set the entered secret in the application. This setup enables data to be sent securely to the DCR using an Entra token.

parameters.label: Deploy Exchange Collector Push connector resources
parameters.applicationDisplayName: Microsoft Exchange On-Premises Collector Push Connector Application

instructionSteps.title: 2. Install the ESI Collector Script on a server with Exchange Admin PowerShell console
instructionSteps.description: This is the script that will collect Exchange Information to push content in Microsoft Sentinel.

instructionSteps.title: Download the latest version of ESI Collector
instructionSteps.description: The latest version can be found here : https://aka.ms/ESI-ExchangeCollector-Script. The file to download is CollectExchSecIns.zip

instructionSteps.title: Copy the script folder
instructionSteps.description: Unzip the content and copy the script folder on a server where Exchange PowerShell Cmdlets are present.

instructionSteps.title: Unblock the PS1 Scripts
instructionSteps.description:
Click right on each PS1 Script and go to Properties tab.
 If the script is marked as blocked, unblock it. You can also use the Cmdlet 'Unblock-File *.* in the unzipped folder using PowerShell.

instructionSteps.title: Configure Network Access
instructionSteps.description: Ensure that the script can contact Azure Analytics (*.ods.opinsights.azure.com).

instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure the ESI Collector Script
instructionSteps.description:
Be sure to be local administrator of the server.
In 'Run as Administrator' mode, launch the 'WinformConfig/SetupCollectExchSecConfiguration.ps1' script to configure the collector.
 Fill the Log Analytics (Microsoft Sentinel) Workspace information.
 Fill the Environment name or leave empty. By default, choose 'Def' as Default analysis. The other choices are for specific usage.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Schedule the ESI Collector Script (If not done by the Install Script due to lack of permission or ignored during installation)
instructionSteps.description:
The script needs to be scheduled to send Exchange configuration to Microsoft Sentinel.
 We recommend to schedule the script once a day.
 The account used to launch the Script needs to be member of the group Organization Management

>**NOTE:** This data connector depends on a parser based on a Kusto Function to work as expected. Parsers are automatically deployed with the solution. Follow the steps to create the Kusto Functions alias : [**ExchangeAdminAuditLogs**](https://aka.ms/sentinel-ESI-ExchangeCollector-ExchangeAdminAuditLogs-parser)

parameters.title: Parsers are automatically deployed during Solution deployment. If you want to deploy manually, follow the steps below

instructionSteps.title: 1. Download the Parser file
instructionSteps.description: The latest version of the file [**ExchangeAdminAuditLogs**](https://aka.ms/sentinel-ESI-ExchangeCollector-ExchangeAdminAuditLogs-parser)

instructionSteps.title: 2. Create Parser **ExchangeAdminAuditLogs** function
instructionSteps.description: In 'Logs' explorer of your Microsoft Sentinel's log analytics, copy the content of the file to Log explorer

instructionSteps.title: 3. Save Parser **ExchangeAdminAuditLogs** function

 No parameter is needed for this parser.
Click save again.
